terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: Please read these terms before you subscribe. By confirming a Smart Play subscription you agree to them.
terms.about.title: 1. About SmartPlay
terms.about.body:
SmartPlay is a 3-in-1 digital subscription service that provides access to three platforms under one subscription:
• QuizPro: An interactive quiz game featuring multiple-choice questions across various knowledge and trivia categories.
• SpeakEasy: AI-powered language learning and speaking practice.
• PlayVerse: An online gaming platform offering over 100 games.
Customers can enjoy all three services through a single SmartPlay subscription.
terms.packages.title: 2. Subscription Packages
terms.free.title: 3. Free Trial Eligibility
terms.free.body:
First-time SmartPlay subscribers are eligible for a free trial based on their selected package:
• Daily Package: 1-day free trial.
• 3-Day Package: 3-day free trial.
The free trial is available only once per eligible subscriber.
terms.activation.title: 4. Subscription and Activation
terms.activation.body:
Customers can subscribe to SmartPlay by selecting their preferred package on the SmartPlay landing page and confirming the subscription.
ATOM subscriber authentication will be performed during the subscription process. Once the subscription is successfully activated, customers can access QuizPro, SpeakEasy, and PlayVerse through the SmartPlay portal.
terms.renew.title: 5. Subscription Charges and Automatic Renewal
terms.renew.body:
• After the free trial ends, the selected subscription fee will be automatically deducted from the customer's ATOM mobile balance unless the subscription is cancelled.
• Daily Package: {daily}, automatically renewed every 24 hours.
• 3-Day Package: {threeDay}, automatically renewed every 72 hours.
terms.cancel.title: 6. Unsubscription and Cancellation
terms.cancel.body:
• Customers can unsubscribe from SmartPlay at any time through the Unsubscribe button in the SmartPlay portal or by dialing {cancelCode}.
• Once unsubscribed, automatic renewal and future subscription charges will stop.
• Customers can continue accessing all three SmartPlay services until the end of their current paid subscription period.
terms.privacy.title: 7. Privacy and Personal Information
terms.privacy.body: All customer personal information will be handled securely and in accordance with applicable privacy and data protection requirements to ensure confidentiality and prevent unauthorized access or disclosure.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information Smart Play uses, why, and the choices you have.
privacy.collect.title: 1. Information we use
privacy.collect.body: Your ATOM mobile number, your subscription status and billing records, basic device and browser details, and how you use the apps (for example game progress and quiz scores).
privacy.use.title: 2. How we use it
privacy.use.body: To start and renew your subscription, to charge your ATOM balance, to send service SMS messages, to answer your questions, and to keep the service working and improve it.
privacy.share.title: 3. Who we share it with
privacy.share.body: ATOM, to process subscriptions and charges, and our content partners, only as needed to run the apps. We do not sell your personal information. We may share it when the law requires.
privacy.keep.title: 4. How long we keep it
privacy.keep.body: We keep your information while you are subscribed and for as long afterwards as billing and legal rules require. Then we delete or anonymise it.
privacy.security.title: 5. Security
privacy.security.body: We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your information from loss and unauthorised access.
privacy.browser.title: 6. Storage in your browser
privacy.browser.body: This page stores small settings, such as your chosen package, in your browser for the current session only. They are removed when you close the tab.
privacy.choices.title: 7. Your choices
privacy.choices.body: You can unsubscribe at any time by dialling {cancelCode} or using the Unsubscribe page. You can also ask us to see or delete your information.
privacy.children.title: 8. Children
privacy.children.body: Users under 18 should use Smart Play only with permission from a parent or guardian.
privacy.changes.title: 9. Changes to this policy
privacy.changes.body: We may update this policy. The latest version is always on this page.
privacy.contact.title: 10. Contact
privacy.contact.body: For privacy questions or requests, please contact Smart Play customer support.
help.title: Help
help.intro: Answers to common questions about Smart Play. Tap a question to see the answer.
help.about.title: What is SmartPlay?
help.about.body:
SmartPlay is a 3-in-1 digital subscription service. One subscription gives you access to:
• QuizPro: An interactive quiz game featuring multiple-choice questions across various knowledge and trivia categories.
• SpeakEasy: AI-powered language learning and speaking practice.
• PlayVerse: An online gaming platform offering over 100 games.
help.trial.title: Is there a free trial?
help.trial.body:
Yes. First-time SmartPlay subscribers get a free trial based on the selected package:
• Daily Package: 1-day free trial.
• 3-Day Package: 3-day free trial.
The free trial is available only once per eligible subscriber.
help.subscribe.title: How do I subscribe?
help.subscribe.body: Choose a package, tap Subscribe Now, then tap Confirm on the ATOM page. You will get a confirmation SMS from ATOM.
help.price.title: How much does it cost?
help.price.body:
• Daily Package: {daily}, automatically renewed every 24 hours.
• 3-Day Package: {threeDay}, automatically renewed every 72 hours.
After the free trial ends, the fee is automatically deducted from your ATOM mobile balance unless you cancel.
help.data.title: It says "Please use ATOM mobile data"
help.data.body: Subscribing only works on ATOM mobile data. Turn off Wi-Fi and any VPN, then tap Try Again.
help.failed.title: My subscription did not go through
help.failed.body: Check that your ATOM balance is enough for the package, then try again in a few minutes.
help.apps.title: How do I open the apps?
help.apps.body: After subscribing, tap Start Playing. Your Smart Play page lists QuizPro, SpeakEasy and PlayVerse; tap Open on any of them.
help.game.title: A game will not load
help.game.body: Games open in a new tab and need an internet connection. Check your connection, close the tab and open the game again.
help.cancel.title: How do I cancel?
help.cancel.body: Tap the Unsubscribe button in the SmartPlay portal or dial {cancelCode} at any time. Automatic renewal and future charges will stop, and you can keep using all three services until the end of your current paid period.
help.contact.title: I still need help
help.contact.body: Please contact Smart Play customer support and tell us your ATOM number and what happened.
